title: A helper called from the loop
prompt: The robot's `health` starts at 100 and recovers 10 points a second, and the recovery lives in a helper called `regen` that the frame loop calls. After 60 frames at 60 per second, health_after_regen reports 110.
hints: regen takes delta and adds 10 times delta to health; _process hands delta on to regen.

docs.name: func _process(delta):
docs.what: Godot calls this once per frame, about 60 times a second. delta is the frame time in seconds.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable keeps its value from one frame to the next.

docs.name: round(x)
docs.what: Returns the nearest whole number as a float.
